name: "Rust Web"

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Rust Windows"]
    branches: [master, instancing_rework]
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  web-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout repository"
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: "Download artifact"
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: output-binaries
          path: output/
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: "Install stable toolchain"
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown
          components: rustfmt, clippy
          
      - name: "Enable use of cache"
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/bin/
            ~/.cargo/registry/index/
            ~/.cargo/registry/cache/
            ~/.cargo/git/db/
            ./crates/target/
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: "Build web assets"
        run: |
          cd crates
          cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --package app
          cd ..
          mkdir -p "./output/web/"
          cp "./crates/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/app.wasm" "./output/web/app.wasm"
          wasm-bindgen --target web "./output/web/app.wasm" --out-dir "./output/web/"
          cp "./web/index.html" "./output/web/index.html"
          cp "./web/spirv_cross_wrapper_glsl.js" "./output/web/spirv_cross_wrapper_glsl.js"
          cp "./web/spirv_cross_wrapper_glsl.wasm" "./output/web/spirv_cross_wrapper_glsl.wasm"
          cp "./web/test.html" "./output/web/test.html"
          cp "./web/test_canvas.html" "./output/web/test_canvas.html"
          cp "./web/webgl.html" "./output/web/webgl.html"
          cp "./web/empty.html" "./output/web/empty.html"
          cp -r "./data_raw" "./output/INOX/data_raw/"

      - name: "Upload web artifacts"
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: web-output
          path: ./output/web/
